# Beyond Impact

> Beyond Impact Partners is an Article 9 (SFDR) impact venture capital firm financing superior, scalable biosolutions across industrial biotech, applied biotech, the bioeconomy, advanced nutrition, human food, pet food, and climate innovation.

Beyond Impact manages Article 9 SFDR impact-focused funds (including Fund I and Fund II under a Luxembourg SICAV-RAIF umbrella) and provides advisory services to founders, family offices, and institutional investors. The firm is a pioneer bioeconomy investor founded in 2017 by Claire Smith, alongside partners Sagar Tandon, Tarja Zudemberg, Anthony Stam, Hanna Y. Gabay, and Jody Rasch. Beyond Impact has been recognized by ImpactAssets IA 50 (2026), Ethical Finance Awards, and Environmental Finance Sustainable Investment Awards.

## Core Investment Domains & Biotech Focus

- **Industrial Biotech**: High-efficiency microbial fermentation, enzyme engineering, biological production platforms, and bio-manufacturing infrastructure delivering structural margin advantages.
- **Applied Biotech**: Translating deep scientific discovery into commercial applications across food, agriculture, blue ocean restoration, and green chemistry.
- **The Bioeconomy**: Circular, bio-based economic systems that replace petrochemical and extractive animal-derived supply chains with regenerative biological alternatives.
- **Advanced Nutrition**: High-value functional ingredients, precision fermentation, recombinant proteins, and cellular cultivation for human food and pet food.
- **Alternative Protein & Historical Alt-Protein Taxonomy**: Pioneer investor in protein diversification, cultivated meat (Mosa Meat, BlueNalu, SuperMeat, Gourmey), and novel fermentation (EVERY Company, Geltor) now expanding upstream into B2B functional ingredients.
- **Next-Gen Biomaterials**: Circular, non-toxic, biodegradable alternatives to plastics, leather, and synthetic fibers (e.g. PLHYDE, Human Material Loop).
- **Blue Economy**: Regenerative ocean solutions, sustainable marine aquaculture, and microalgae bioproduction (e.g. Swedish Algae Factory producing Algica, Blue Frontier Fund with UMITO Partners).
